responsibility: Lowers HIR generic bounds and where-clause predicates into internal `ty` predicates, including implied `Sized` handling, trait and projection bound expansion, and validation of associated-const binding types against escaping generic parameters or late-bound variables.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `bounds.rs`, this file is the lowering logic that interprets HIR bound syntax, adds implied `Sized`, expands trait/projection bounds, and validates associated-const binding types before inserting clauses into `Bounds`.
